verdict.rationale: The e-Services for Business portal documents only manual, one-off actions: filing returns, making or moving payments, adding payment plans, viewing notices, and reporting new employees. Nothing in the evidence describes user-defined rules or event-triggered automation. The probes found no API surface (no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt), and the transactional portal returns 403 to agents, so there is no basis for crediting this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
